title: QuickFix XP
description: QuickFix XP is a handy utility mod that allows you to instantly repair your tools and armor using your accumulated experience points. No more standing idle at XP farms—the forge is now in your hands!
body:
✨ QuickFix XP — Your Portable Forge!
Tired of idling at XP farms while your tools slowly mend? QuickFix XP converts your hard-earned experience into raw restorative energy. Repair your gear instantly, anytime, anywhere!

🛠 Core Features:
  🧤 Manual Care (Shift + RMB): Hold an item and Shift-Right Click to repair it slowly. This is the eco-friendly method with a standard rate ($1$ XP = $2$ Durability).
  ⚡ Instant Surge (Hotkey 'R'): One press fully repairs the item in your main hand. Convenience tax: XP cost is doubled (x2).
  🌀 Master Mender (Hotkey 'K'): A massive burst of energy that repairs ALL items in your inventory with the Mending enchantment. Convenience tax: XP cost is doubled (x2).
⚖️ Balance & Fair Play:
  🌑 Curse of Vanishing: Items with this curse resist restoration. Repairing them will cost you 3 times more XP.
  📖 The gerakOD Guide: Every new player receives a detailed bilingual guidebook upon their first login. Lost it? Use /quickfixxp book.
  🖥 Immersive HUD: Enjoy full-screen titles and visual feedback when performing mass repairs—know exactly when your gear is back in prime shape.
